title: Workplace Red-Flag Relay
scenario: Workplace online play: each player has 20 seconds to name one niche red flag from the last Workplace card without repeating another player.

answers.A: Complete the relay with no repeats.

explanation: Workplace Red-Flag Relay: the purpose is to turn the last scenario into active recall, not passive reading. It rewards naming a precise safer action instead of giving vague advice.
proTip: Use it only after a scenario card, never as a separate mini-game.
